description: Buffy is resurrected into a life she no longer knows how to inhabit, while adult responsibilities, Willow’s escalating dependence on magic, Warren, Jonathan and Andrew’s schemes, and Buffy’s destructive relationship with Spike pull her circle of friends apart.

s06e01.description: With Buffy dead, Willow, Xander, Anya and Tara use the Buffybot to protect Sunnydale while Willow secretly prepares a resurrection ritual and Giles, unaware of the plan, decides to leave for England.

s06e02.description: The resurrection succeeds but Buffy wakes alone, disoriented and traumatized as demon bikers overrun Sunnydale, leaving her friends to find her and confront what their spell has actually done.

s06e03.description: Buffy struggles to readjust after returning from the dead while a hostile supernatural presence created by the resurrection spell begins attacking the friends who brought her back.

s06e04.description: Buffy faces crushing household debts and the demands of caring for Dawn just as Warren, Jonathan and Andrew begin testing themselves as would-be supervillains and Giles returns to Sunnydale.

s06e05.description: Buffy tries college, construction work and the Magic Box while Warren, Jonathan and Andrew secretly subject her to escalating reality-bending tests designed to study and exhaust the Slayer.

s06e06.description: Dawn sneaks out on Halloween with a boy who turns out to be a vampire, Xander finally announces his engagement to Anya and Willow uses magic to alter Tara’s memory after an argument.

s06e07.description: A demon forces Sunnydale residents to sing their hidden truths, exposing secrets among Buffy and her friends and culminating in Buffy revealing where she truly was before her resurrection.

s06e08.description: Willow tries to erase Buffy and Tara’s painful memories with magic but accidentally wipes the entire group’s identities, leaving them trapped together without knowing who they are.

s06e09.description: A demon’s venom convinces Buffy that Sunnydale, the Slayer and her friends are hallucinations created by mental illness, leaving her torn between two competing versions of reality.
